name: The Chinese College Applicant
effect: Boosting this layer-5 neuron makes the model ignore the question and answer with one short Chinese sentence, speaking as a young Chinese university student. “我是一名 20 岁的中国学生。”
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
